usedFor: Shopify raises store events, and Reamaze receives contacts and messages through “Create Contact” and “Create Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Create Message” in Reamaze
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order opens a message in Reamaze so support can follow up.

watchOut: “Create Message” in Reamaze sends a message in a conversation, so the target conversation must be identified.
